title: Unit Event — On Your Feet — Episode2 Back To Practice

meta.Event Outline: After learning the truth behind RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD are more determined than ever to surpass that legendary night. The group decide to do what they can for the time being, but Kohane's thoughts linger on her former mentor Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for agreeing to help us again today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent start!
Try to keep that up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She seems to have a clear image of how she wants her voice to be heard.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We've made our decision!
This is our new starting point!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to remember what I felt...
During our third event, and when we faced off against Taiga...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh wow.
Looks like Kohane's bringing her A game!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Akito, why don't we try to do the same?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He's singing with a lot of power...
I need to do the same.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I know how you feel. So, why don't we also get started?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, Len!
Could you lend me a hand again?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want you to pay close attention to how these two sing. Think about where they expend energy or refrain and try to recreate that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll do just that!
Thank you both for doing this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There...
I fell behind you again, Miku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I'm not done yet...!
Let's go one more time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the spirit.
I'll go as many times as you want.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(There's no point in thinking about that.
I have to focus on what I'm doing now... I need to do much more...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
But I'm starting to hear fatigue in your voices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So am I. It's getting late, so why don't we call things here for now? We wouldn't want your families to worry.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, it is getting late...
I gotta get home!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, you shouldn't push yourself so hard. Overdoing it is only going to backfire.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's right. Knowing when to take breaks is also important.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, MEIKO, thank you very much for letting us borrow your cafe again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. It's always my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll see you all again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
Soma, Tono's partner... He just sent me a message...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you think Soma's like...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You two haven't met him yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we never got a chance to go with Arata to the hospital since stuff kept coming up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As for what Soma is like...
He's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Friendly, easy to talk to...and clearly loves music very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you two will also enjoy meeting him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was a little worried since we're coming along on such short notice. But I'm really excited now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hope we can find out how Arata's doing. Soma might still be in contact with him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
It'll be nice to sit down and talk with him.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Oh, hey.
Isn't that Vivid BAD SQUAD...?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Didn't Taiga totally demolish them the other day?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone's been talking about that battle. Winning in style's one thing, but that was pretty mean of him...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I really thought they had a chance against him. Guess this means no one's ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one's ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course they'd think that...
I mean, there was just that big of a skill gap between us and Uncle Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
In any case, let's go...
We don't have time for this right now.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I mean, this is sorta what they get for going around saying they're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I know, right? Did they really think that they could become even more legendary than Taiga and his team?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You kids get your kicks laughing at the people who try?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Huh?
You talkin' to us, gramps?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Crap...!
That's the owner of Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
...
I'm guessing you heard from Ken?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yeah, he said he told them everything.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I guess this is it...
About time we all got our comeuppance, eh?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Nagi's wishes were just part of it.
We put a whole lot on An's shoulders.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I feel awful about what we did to her.
At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: If An has come to terms with Nagi's last wishes... I can't help but feel excited...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: There isn't much us old folks can do for her and her friends. We should stand aside and let them walk down the path they've chosen...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No gawkers here. I think we're far enough away now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess everyone really is talking about our battle against Taiga...
